periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree upward diagonal tilt from the medial canthus towards the lateral-superior cranial region.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.8:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering of the patch below the ocular center, extending toward the lower cheek area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Consistent semi-circular curvature at the superior margins of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Open mouth posture exposing mandibular dentition and tongue; elongated fur fibers under the chin creating a prominent ventral ruff.
